_comment: Deep water IS water, and saying so here is what buys nearly all of its behaviour for nothing.
`Entity.isInWater`, swimming, drowning, boats, extinguishing, what a squid may live in and what a
conduit reaches all test `#minecraft:water` -- so an abyss is a sea to everything that asks a question
about it, and the only thing that differs is what standing under eighty blocks of it does to you.
It is also what makes the continuity scan in `DeepWater.columnFrom` a single tag check: 'water or
deep water, unbroken' is one predicate rather than two, and the two can never come apart.
The one thing to watch if this is ever revisited: vanilla rules keyed on this tag apply here too --
freezing, sponges, farmland hydration. None of them can reach an abyss in practice, since deep water
cannot exist within eighty blocks of a surface, but a rule that reads the tag at depth would.
